gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the XGIMI Portable Outdoor Screen, which ChatGPT picked as 'Best for travel' at $99 without giving a size, is only a 70-inch screen. That is 49% of the picture area of a 100-inch screen. On the same day, VEVOR's own store sold a 100-inch 16:9 tripod screen for $90.99.
standout_why: I compared this against projectorverdict.com 'Best Projector Screen 2026' (11-05) and 'Best Tripod Projector Screen 2026' (10-30), which I opened. Neither page covers the XGIMI screen. Neither gives a weight for the Yard Master 2, and neither compares portable screens on size per dollar. I could not open the cited Wirecutter page (403 through the proxy, blocked directly) or the Esquire page (blocked), so I can't rule out that either one mentions the XGIMI's 70-inch size. That is why this scores 2 and not 3.
decides: It confirms the Elite Yard Master 2 as the tensioned-frame pick. Its store price starts at $160, and ProjectorVerdict listed the 105-inch at $273 on 2026-10-31. It knocks the XGIMI out of a general 'best portable' list, because $99 buys a 70-inch screen while VEVOR's $90.99 tripod screen is 100 inches. The XGIMI only makes sense when a 3.3 lb backpack screen is the requirement. It also shows the Lihong 80-inch pull-up is not a budget pick: Amazon listed it at $209 for 80 inches.
